summary: One glyph of the owned Codelab icon font; decorative unless labelled; reading-direction glyphs mirror in RTL.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name (translated); omit for a decorative icon next to visible text.

inputs.name: flipInRtl
inputs.description: Mirror in RTL; defaults to the manifest setting of the icon.

a11y: aria-hidden without a label; role=img with aria-label when labelled.
